The install script clones the CrabCraft monorepo (authenticating with GITHUB_TOKEN for the private repo), installs dependencies, and bundles the Infisical CLI. On each start, pterodactyl/start.sh logs into Infisical via machine-identity universal auth and runs the bot through `infisical run`, so bot secrets (Discord token, database URLs, API keys) are injected from your Infisical project at launch. installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CrabCraft Bot - Pterodactyl install bootstrap.
# Clones the repo, then hands off to pterodactyl/install.sh in the repo.
# Edits to the real install logic go to pterodactyl/install.sh (no egg
# re-import needed).
set -e

echo "==> CrabCraft Bot bootstrap starting"

apt -y update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates gnupg

# /mnt/server is owned by the container user (UID 988); this script runs
# as root, so git's safe-ownership check would otherwise abort.
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'

GIT_URL="${GIT_REPO_URL:-https://github.com/CrabCraftMC/CrabCraft.git}"
GIT_REF="${GIT_REF:-main}"

echo "==> Repo: ${GIT_URL}"
echo "==> Ref:  ${GIT_REF}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.local/bin

# Bundled git credential helper: reads GITHUB_TOKEN from env at use time
# so the token never lands in .git/config or on any process command line.
cat > /mnt/server/.local/bin/git-askpass.sh <<'ASK'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
    Username*) echo "x-access-token" ;;
    *) echo "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ;;
esac
ASK
chmod +x /mnt/server/.local/bin/git-askpass.sh

if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    export GIT_ASKPASS=/mnt/server/.local/bin/git-askpass.sh
    export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
    echo "==> GITHUB_TOKEN detected; using GIT_ASKPASS helper for clone/fetch"
else
    echo "==> GITHUB_TOKEN not set; private repos will fail to clone"
fi

cd /mnt/server

if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "==> Refreshing existing checkout"
    git remote set-url origin "${GIT_URL}"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_REF}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
    git clean -fd -e node_modules -e .local
else
    echo "==> Cloning fresh"
    tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
    git clone --branch "${GIT_REF}" --depth 1 "${GIT_URL}" "${tmpdir}"
    shopt -s dotglob
    cp -r "${tmpdir}/." /mnt/server/
    rm -rf "${tmpdir}"
fi

if [ -f pterodactyl/install.sh ]; then
    echo "==> Handing off to pterodactyl/install.sh"
    exec bash pterodactyl/install.sh
else
    echo "FATAL: pterodactyl/install.sh not found in repo at ${GIT_REF}." >&2
    exit 1
fi

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (classic with `repo` scope, or a fine-grained token with read access to the CrabCraft repo). Required for cloning the private monorepo at install and for AUTO_UPDATE pulls. Stays in env only — never written to .git/config.

variables.name: Infisical Client ID
variables.description: Machine identity client ID from Infisical (Universal Auth). Find under Project → Access Control → Machine Identities.

variables.name: Infisical Client Secret
variables.description: Machine identity client secret paired with the client ID above. Treat as a secret.

variables.name: Infisical Project ID
variables.description: Infisical project ID (a.k.a. workspace ID) that holds the bot's secrets.

variables.name: Infisical Environment
variables.description: Environment slug to pull secrets from (e.g. prod, staging, dev).

variables.name: Infisical Domain (self-hosted)
variables.description: Optional. Base URL for a self-hosted Infisical instance (e.g. https://infisical.example.com). Leave blank to use Infisical Cloud (https://app.infisical.com).

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Git URL to clone/pull the CrabCraft monorepo from. Change only if you maintain a fork.

variables.name: Git Ref (branch/tag/sha)
variables.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out. Defaults to main.

variables.name: Auto-update on restart
variables.description: When 1, git-fetch the configured ref and reinstall dependencies on every start. Set to 0 to pin the running version.
